properties.name: WHAT WORKED (field log 2026-10-05, re-measured): the old sligara7/reflow2 addresses still reach the repository after its move to flo2-connector. The API, raw install.sh and release-asset URLs all resolve, so the two install URLs in circulation lead to one repository. Do not regress it. The container image's old name does not redirect, by design (UPDATING.md)
properties.statement:
Field log entry [works] (art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05, lines 371-374): "`sligara7/reflow2` redirects to `flo2-connector/reflow2` (`gh api repos/sligara7/reflow2` returns the latter), so the two URLs in circulation (install.sh in hxm_program AGENTS.md vs. the release recipe) are the same repo."

RE-MEASURED 2026-10-05:
- `gh api repos/sligara7/reflow2` gives full_name flo2-connector/reflow2.
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sligara7/reflow2/main/tools/install.sh answers 200.
- https://github.com/sligara7/reflow2/releases/download/v0.79.0/checksums.txt resolves to the release asset.

The redirect is GitHub's. It holds only while nobody creates a repository at sligara7/reflow2 again. The GHCR image name does not redirect: UPDATING.md says images from v0.79.0 on are published only as ghcr.io/flo2-connector/reflow2/reflow2-mcp.
